messages:
ada: Heads-up: partner pen-test intake landed. Need to finalize: RBAC freeze window, KMS/HSM access pattern (no decrypt), artifact escrow format, and a 30-min dry-run next day.

ben: Dates? scope?

ada: Window 2026-03-20 09:00 -> 2026-03-21 17:00 UTC. Scope = staging + feature-integration cluster. KMS HSM signing only; no decrypts.

carla: For KMS: we will provide sealed ciphertext objects and a signing-only proxy endpoint. If assessors ask for crypto ops, they must call `POST /hsm-proxy/sign` and we will log the full payload and response hash.

infra-runner: I'll create ephemeral OKTA roles mapped to assessor emails. TTL 4h default. Command I will run: `./grant-ephemeral --principal assessor:partner --scopes staging:read,kms-proxy:sign --ttl 4h`

ada: Artifact escrow format: gzipped tarball `evidence-<partner>-YYYYMMDD.tar.gz` with directories `audit/`, `configs/`, `objects/`, and `meta/`. `meta/manifest.csv` columns: path, sha256, size, type, owner, export_tool_version, timestamp. Provide a `meta/README.md` describing verification steps.

ben: We'll GPG-sign the manifest and include `meta/manifest.sig` and `meta/gpg_fingerprint.txt`. Also include per-file sha512 in `meta/sha512sums.txt` for extra verification.

carla: KMS/HSM logging fields required: timestamp, request_id, principal, operation, key_alias, key_slot, payload_hash, response_code, authorization_hint, trace_id, duration_ms. Include `requester_ip` if available.

sec-automation-bot: scheduled: "Pen Test - Pre-engagement Dry-run" 2026-03-19 08:00 UTC. Reminder will be sent 24h prior.

infra-runner: Retention: artifacts held in escrow S3 for 90 days by default. Legal requested 180 days for this partner; will set 180 days. Path: `s3://pt-escrow/partner-20260320/`. Will post presigned GET link (7-day validity) once upload complete. Placeholder: `https://presigned.redwood/pt/partner-20260320`

ben: Triage & retest gate proposal: Critical/P0/P1 = block until fixed & verified; High/P2 = mitigation + test plan required; Medium/Low schedule. For anything touching KMS/HSM, require `kms_policy_before.json`, `kms_policy_after.json`, and `repro_steps.md`.

ada: Add RBAC freeze: IAM role edits in staging disabled during engagement day (00:00-23:59 UTC). Exception flow: `./request-rbac-exception --ticket <URL>` requires dual approval from sec-owner + infra lead and auto-logs to `rbac_changes.log`.

infra-runner: I'll post the runbook & the presigned URL in this thread after dry-run. Dry-run tomorrow 08:00 UTC to test: presigned upload, manifest generation & signing, hsm-proxy sign-test, and RBAC exception flow.

carla: I'll run the KMS proxy log verification script during dry-run and confirm all required fields present. Example verification: `jq -r '.[] | [.timestamp,.request_id,.principal,.operation,.key_alias,.payload_hash] | @csv' hsm-logs.ndjson`

ben: I'll create a sample evidence tar with small sample objects + manifest.csv and upload to presigned sample path by EOD today.

ada: Great. Owners: ada -> overall coord + triage; infra-runner -> presigned path + ephemeral roles; carla -> KMS proxy + logs; ben -> packaging + manifest signing. sec-automation-bot: create calendar; done.

ada: Thanks all. Dry-run tomorrow 08:00 UTC. :rocket:
